notes.nkulinze: Ma ope mi: I wait for you.
notes.ndi-mu-kkubo: Ma geri dria: I am on the road.

guidebook.intro: On the phone. **Omvi** is call: **Ma ka mi omvi drusi** (I will call you tomorrow).

tips.title: Halo? A’di a’yo?
body: Answer with **Halo? A’di a’yo?** (who is speaking?). **Ma eri mi muke ku** (I can’t hear you well).
**Se e’yo sezu ma ni** (send me a message).

tips.title: Ama ra
body: **Ama ra sawa su** (let’s meet at ten). **Ma ope mi** (I’m waiting for you), **Ma geri dria** (I’m on the way).

culture.title: Mobile money
body: Phones are used for calls, messages and mobile money; airtime is sold at every kiosk.
